nodes.label: Whisper Handshake Pending
nodes.description: Connection established, awaiting Whisper status message exchange

nodes.label: Send Status Message
nodes.description: Send status message (0x00) with version, PoW requirement, and optional bloom filter

nodes.description: Both peers have exchanged status messages, ready for envelope exchange

nodes.label: Send Message Envelopes
nodes.description: Send message envelopes (0x01) containing encrypted payloads

nodes.label: Message Envelope Received
nodes.description: An envelope has been received from a peer

nodes.label: Update PoW Requirement
nodes.description: Send PoW requirement update (0x02) to adjust minimum proof-of-work

nodes.label: Update Bloom Filter
nodes.description: Send bloom filter update (0x03) to adjust topic interest

sub_graphs.title: EIP-627: Envelope Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of Whisper message envelopes

nodes.label: Envelope Received
nodes.description: A message envelope has been received and needs validation

nodes.label: Validate Envelope Structure
nodes.description: Validate envelope format: [Expiry(4), TTL(4), Topic(4), Data(var), Nonce(8)]

nodes.label: Validate Proof-of-Work
nodes.description: Verify envelope meets minimum PoW requirement (not NaN, INF, or negative)

nodes.label: Check Bloom Filter Match
nodes.description: Verify envelope topic matches node's bloom filter interests

nodes.label: Envelope Accepted
nodes.description: Envelope passed all validation and is accepted for processing

nodes.label: Envelope Rejected
nodes.description: Envelope failed validation and is silently dropped

nodes.label: Disconnect Misbehaving Peer
nodes.description: Disconnect from peer violating protocol (e.g., sending expired messages)

edges.label: PoW below minimum or invalid value

sub_graphs.title: EIP-627: Whisper Encryption and Privacy
sub_graphs.description: Models the cryptographic boundaries protecting message privacy

nodes.label: Plaintext Message Ready
nodes.description: Application has a plaintext message to send

nodes.label: Encrypt with ECIES
nodes.description: Encrypt message using ECIES (Elliptic Curve Integrated Encryption Scheme)

nodes.label: Encrypt with AES-GCM
nodes.description: Encrypt message using AES-GCM symmetric encryption

nodes.label: Sign with ECDSA
nodes.description: Sign message using ECDSA with Keccak-256 on SECP-256k1

nodes.label: Apply Padding
nodes.description: Apply 256-byte alignment padding to prevent size-based metadata leakage

nodes.label: Encrypted Envelope Ready
nodes.description: Message is encrypted, signed, padded, and ready for transmission

nodes.label: Encrypted Envelope Received
nodes.description: Encrypted envelope received from network

nodes.label: Decrypt Message
nodes.description: Attempt to decrypt envelope using available keys

nodes.label: Message Decrypted
nodes.description: Message successfully decrypted and verified

external_entities.description: Application layer using Whisper for private messaging

ambiguities.text: The specification states 'at most, three bits are marked for each bloomed topic' without specifying the exact algorithm.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard bloom filter implementation with 3 hash functions mapping topics to 512-bit space.

ambiguities.text: Packet codes 0x7E (P2P Request) and 0x7F (P2P Message) are marked as 'reserved' without specification.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these codes are for future direct peer-to-peer messaging features not yet standardized.

ambiguities.text: Unknown packet codes 'must be ignored' but it's unclear if this includes malformed packets.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume malformed packets (invalid encoding) should be rejected, but unknown valid packet codes should be silently ignored.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot break ECIES or AES-GCM encryption within the message TTL timeframe.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Message confidentiality would be compromised, allowing attackers to read private communications.

implicit_assumptions.description: The bloom filter provides sufficient privacy to hide exact topic interests.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could correlate bloom filter patterns with specific topics, enabling traffic analysis attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient network peers exist to provide anonymity through message mixing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: With few peers, message origin could be more easily determined through timing analysis.
